messages:
irene: opened a focused PR to tighten SOC2 audit-log wording and add a minimal Node + curl export snippet; also fixed one broken internal anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/710
sam: quick read  looks sensible. two asks: 1) be explicit that exports are point-in-time snapshots and do NOT extend or change tenant TTLs; 2) call out who can request exports / place legal holds. auditors flagged both.
irene: added sentence: 'Snapshot exports capture data at request time and do not modify the configured retention TTL for stored logs.' RBAC line: 'Only Organization Admins and users assigned the Compliance role may request exports, place or release legal holds, or change retention settings.'
legal-sr: wording ok. replace 'permanent' with 'indefinite' where we previously used it; add link to internal retention guidance: https://internal/legal/retention-policy. include one-line legal-hold lifecycle: 'Legal holds suspend scheduled deletions until released by Legal; hold actions are recorded in the audit trail.'
irene: switched to 'indefinite', added link and lifecycle note. included tiny Node and curl snippets and one failure example for redaction not configured (customers asked about this):
```js
// Node example
await client.audit.export({ tenantId: 'acme', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2024-01-31', redactPII: true });
// possible error -> 422 {"error":"redaction_not_configured","message":"PII redaction not enabled for tenant"}
```
```bash
# curl export example (requires OrgAdmin or Compliance role)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","start":"2024-01-01","end":"2024-01-31","redact":true}'
```
doc-bot: PR 710 updated, link-check passed, staging build green.
irene: will merge tomorrow AM if no objections. thanks everyone :thumbsup:"
